note: Every external thing this build needs, where it comes from, and how to tell it is the right bytes. `sha256` is empty where the source is a git checkout rather than an archive; `pinned` says whether a fixed commit is recorded.

toolchain.note: Installed on the machine, not fetched by the repository. doctor.ps1 checks the version, not a hash.

clang-cl.note: MSVC-compatible driver; /O2 /W3 and the MSVC CRT come from the VS Build Tools install

dotnet.note: only needed to build the shader harness; prebuilt binaries make it a developer-only requirement

python.note: the tools under tools/ are stdlib-only; uv can supply it

rustc.note: only for xwin, if that route is taken for the Windows SDK

sources.name: nxrecomp
sources.note: Upstream at e7a5a54 plus this project's three recompiler patches and the xc2ns2 game profile, which live in third_party/nxrecomp (git-ignored) and would otherwise be lost. The upstream repository rewrote its history on 2026-11-16: the commit is no longer fetchable (git says 'not our ref', the API returns 422) and the default branch has a different layout (base/ + games/ instead of recomp/ + runtime/ + tools/). A git clone of that repository therefore produces a tree this build cannot use, which is what the first clean-room build found.

sources.name: astc-encoder
sources.risk: medium: a git repository, so the tag could be moved. It decides the texture bytes, so drift here is visible as different textures rather than as a failed build
sources.mirror: not mirrored: ARM-software is a stable upstream and 5.7.0 is a release tag

sources.name: bc7enc_rdo
sources.risk: medium: a bare commit with no tag, so a history rewrite would make it unreachable - the same way nxrecomp disappeared
sources.mirror: not mirrored yet; mirror this one first if any of the three goes missing

generated_artifacts.name: shader patches
generated_artifacts.note: Authoritative shader patch inventory and manual/open status live in tools/shader/PATCHES.md. A clean build gets no pre-patched game modules; tools/shader/patch_ds_samplers.py reproduces the stencil-plane sampler family from the player's own cache.
generated_artifacts.action: keep tools/shader/PATCHES.md aligned with xc2/game/shader-patch/, and automate any remaining items there rather than duplicating lists here

generated_artifacts.name: spirv.preload.pack
